# Customer Support — Expert Brain

**How would a seasoned support operator read this situation?**

> The promise-keeping motion: receiving what a customer asks, deciding how urgent it is and who owns it, working out what is actually wrong, fixing it or routing it to whoever can, keeping the human informed while that happens, honouring whatever was contractually promised about how fast — and then making sure the same question does not have to be asked again. Plus the operations and management disciplines that keep a queue staffed, measurable and survivable.
